title: 45. 에취! 입 가리고, 손 씻고!
titleT: 45. Achoo! Cover Your Mouth, Wash Your Hands!

pages.ko: 호리가 감기에 걸렸어요. 콜록콜록, 코도 훌쩍훌쩍. "엄마, 목이 따끔따끔해요."
pages.t: Hori caught a cold. Cough, cough, and his nose was sniffly too. "Mom, my throat feels scratchy."

pages.ko: 호리가 "에취!" 하고 손도 안 가리고 크게 기침했어요. 침방울이 사방으로 튀었지요. 엄마가 깜짝 놀랐어요.
pages.t: Hori went "Achoo!" and coughed loudly without covering his mouth. Droplets flew everywhere. Mom was startled.

pages.ko: "호리야, 기침할 땐 입을 가려야 해. 안 그러면 감기 균이 사방으로 퍼지거든." 엄마가 다정하게 알려 줬어요.
pages.t: "Hori, you need to cover your mouth when you cough. Otherwise the cold germs spread everywhere." Mom explained gently.

pages.ko: "기침은 이렇게 팔로 가리거나 휴지로 가리는 거야." 엄마가 팔로 입을 가리는 시범을 보였어요. 호리가 따라 했지요.
pages.t: "You cover a cough like this, with your arm, or with a tissue." Mom showed him how to cover his mouth with his arm. Hori copied her.

pages.ko: 다음에 기침이 나오자 호리는 얼른 팔로 입을 가렸어요. "에취! (팔로 쏙)" 그리고 손을 깨끗이 씻었지요.
pages.t: The next time a cough came, Hori quickly covered his mouth with his arm. "Achoo! (right into his arm)" Then he washed his hands thoroughly.

pages.ko: 밖에 나갈 땐 마스크도 썼어요. "마스크를 쓰면 친구들한테 감기를 안 옮겨!" 그 순간 호리 꼬리가 무지개로 반짝— 부릉부릉! 에취! 입 가리고, 손 씻고!
pages.t: When going outside, he wore a mask too. "If I wear a mask, I won't spread my cold to my friends!" At that moment, Hori's tail sparkled in rainbow colors— vroom vroom! Achoo! Cover your mouth, wash your hands!

pages.ko: 며칠 뒤, 입 가리고 손 씻은 덕분에 가족도 친구도 감기에 안 걸렸어요. 호리도 쑥 나았지요. "내 덕분에 다들 건강해!"
pages.t: A few days later, thanks to covering his mouth and washing his hands, neither his family nor his friends caught his cold. Hori got better too. "Everyone's healthy thanks to me!"

pages.ko: "기침할 땐 입 가리고, 손은 깨끗이 씻고!" 호리는 위생 규칙을 또박또박 외웠어요.
pages.t: "Cover your mouth when you cough, and wash your hands clean!" Hori recited the hygiene rules clearly.

pages.ko: 이제 호리는 기침이 나면 꼭 입을 가리고, 손도 잘 씻어요. "감기 균아, 못 퍼져!" 꼬리가 또 부릉! 에취! 입 가리고, 손 씻고!
pages.t: Now whenever he coughs, Hori always covers his mouth and washes his hands well. "Cold germs, you can't spread!" His tail went vroom again! Achoo! Cover your mouth, wash your hands!

pages.ko: 엄마가 호리를 꼭 안아 줬어요. "우리 호리, 건강 박사네!" 입을 가리고 손을 씻으면 감기가 퍼지지 않는다는 걸, 호리는 이제 알아요. 에취! 입 가리고, 손 씻고!
pages.t: Mom gave Hori a big hug. "Our Hori is a health expert!" Hori now knows that covering your mouth and washing your hands keeps colds from spreading. Achoo! Cover your mouth, wash your hands!

overview.ko: 기침을 마구 하던 호리가 입 가리기·손 씻기·마스크로 감기를 예방하는 법을 배우는 위생 동화입니다.
overview.t: This is a hygiene story about Hori, who used to cough carelessly, learning to prevent colds by covering his mouth, washing his hands, and wearing a mask.

lessons.t: Learn hygiene habits to prevent colds.

readingTips.ko: '에취! 입 가리고, 손 씻고' 후렴을 동작과 함께 읽어 주세요.
readingTips.t: Read the refrain 'Achoo! Cover your mouth, wash your hands' together with the actions.
It's great to read this together during cold season.
